claims.text: The Monitor attributes the April 2026 peak in Southeast Asian ethylene spot prices principally to concurrent supply outages: a planned turnaround at Pengerang, which the operator extended into a force majeure declaration, overlapping with the tail of the Cilegon furnace replacement programme in March.

citations.quote: The Monitor attributes the April peak principally to concurrent supply outages: a planned turnaround at Pengerang, which the operator extended into a force majeure declaration, overlapping with the tail of the Cilegon furnace replacement programme in March.

claims.text: Selat Kimia Berhad declared force majeure on ethylene deliveries from its Pengerang complex in April 2026, extending the outage beyond the planned duration due to corrosion found in a quench tower during scheduled turnaround.

citations.quote:
Selat Kimia Berhad has declared force majeure on ethylene deliveries from its Pengerang complex with immediate effect.

The company said inspection during the current scheduled turnaround identified corrosion in a quench tower internal that requires replacement, extending the outage beyond the planned duration.

claims.text: Nusantara Olefins completed the expansion of Cilegon Cracker 1 in March 2026, replacing four cracking furnaces and upgrading the quench section, with the unit returning to service at an ethylene capacity of 1,200 kta.

citations.quote:
Nusantara Olefins announced today that the expansion of Cilegon Cracker 1 has been mechanically completed and the unit has returned to service. Following the expansion, the company describes the unit as having an ethylene capacity of 1,200 kta.

The expansion replaced four cracking furnaces and upgraded the quench section.

claims.text: Assessments eased through May and June 2026 as both the Pengerang and Cilegon units returned to service after their outages.

citations.quote: Assessments eased through May and June as both units returned.

claims.text: Asian naphtha prices firmed steadily in the first half of 2026 due to Northeast Asian refinery maintenance, compressing cracker margins even where olefin prices rose.

citations.quote: Feedstock costs contributed. Asian naphtha firmed steadily across the period on Northeast Asian refinery maintenance, compressing cracker margins even where olefin prices rose.

claims.text: Naphtha remains the dominant feedstock for ethylene production in Southeast Asia, except in Brunei where ethane is used.

citations.quote: Naphtha remains the dominant feedstock across the region, with the exception of Brunei, where ethane is used.

claims.text: Luzon Resins Corporation reported stable operations across its Batangas complex for the year ending February 2026, with no unplanned outages at the cracker.

citations.quote: Luzon Resins Corporation reported stable operations across its Batangas complex for the year, with no unplanned outages at the cracker.

claims.text: Berth congestion at Southeast Asian container terminals in October and November 2025 led to delays of up to eleven days for polymer export cargoes, tightening prompt cargo availability and firming regional polyethylene and polypropylene offers.

citations.quote:
Berth congestion at several Southeast Asian container terminals lengthened waiting times for polymer export cargoes through October and November, with delays of up to eleven days reported at peak.

Resin shipments were among the affected categories. Regional polyethylene and polypropylene offers firmed over the period as available prompt cargoes tightened.

gaps.subject: Aggregate regional ethylene capacity totals
gaps.detail: The Monitor does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in its bulletins; readers are directed to its capacity database for unit-level data.

citations.quote: The Monitor does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in this bulletin.

coverage_note: Coverage is strong for major outages, expansions, and feedstock trends. No aggregate regional capacity figures are published in the cited bulletins. No evidence of new Southeast Asian cracker startups or major expansions beyond Cilegon in the period. Middle East developments (e.g., Gulf Meridian Chemicals' Jubail expansion) are out of scope for Southeast Asia.
